## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle alternative recension of [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Dharmarakṣa's *[Lùmǔ jīng (T182a)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0037)*, in slightly different textual state. Signature: 「西晉三藏法師竺法護譯」. For narrative content and bibliography, see [KR6b0037](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0037).

**Abstract**

T182b is the parallel-recension companion of T182a in the Sòng / Yuán canonical traditions; the translation is identical to T182a in substance.
